incrementalReviews.note: The four class-overhaul integration daggers and the soul_stone painting, generated under woc-item-icon-v1 and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-10; the 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files stands unchanged.

visualCriteria: player-facing object identity and family coherence
reviewContract.highResolutionReview: Flagged and retried assets were additionally reviewed from their retained 512px masters.

visualVerdict.summary: All 825 shipping item-art files pass the visual contract: 817 reviewed in the 2026-08-09 campaign (documented retries included), the five class-overhaul integration additions owner-reviewed and passed on 2026-08-10, and the three junk-mount reins icons reviewed on 2026-08-14 (machine checks only: each is rendered from its own mount GLB and composited onto the style-guide vignette ground, so no painted-master style contract is claimed).

nonVisualContentWatch.reason: The art correctly depicts the runtime chest slot, but the player-facing name is Skullsmasher's Warbelt.
nonVisualContentWatch.recommendation: Resolve the content name/slot decision separately; do not repaint the chest icon as a belt while the item remains slot=chest.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The first repaint read as an empty white hood rather than a narrow circlet.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live silver circlet retains its full oval band and centerpiece at 128, 40, 28, grayscale, and circular size.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The first repaint contained several lines of accidental pseudo-writing.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live scroll uses only deliberate embossed circles, triangles, and diamonds and remains legible at every review size.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The prior shard was too thin and dark to retain useful visual mass at 28 pixels.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live celestial mineral has a broader silhouette and distinct blue-violet value separation at tiny and circular sizes.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The prior staff had a near-black, very thin shaft and head that collapsed at tiny sizes.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live lantern-cage head and brighter shaft remain distinct at 28 pixels and in the circular crop.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The upper half, lower half, and assembled quest reward used three unrelated object languages despite quest text saying the halves fit together.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live trio is one complementary cracked stone-and-bronze keystone set with a shared violet arch and crown motif.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The legacy source and first repaint depicted a tied salami roll rather than salted jerky.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The legacy source and first repaint depicted uncooked dough beneath a rolling pin rather than finished hardtack.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live icon depicts a tied stack of baked pierced travel biscuits that remains readable at 28 pixels.
